sources.finding: Every changelog entry dated 2026-10-27 to 2026-11-12 (listing pages 1 to 4; page 4 resumes at 2026-10-23, so no entry exists for 2026-10-24 to 2026-10-26) was read by title, and the only stock market-data entry was opened. None documents a change to the raw stock-bar price basis.

The adjustment parameter on GET /v2/stocks/bars and /v2/stocks/{symbol}/bars is now typed as an enum array. The HTTP query shape is unchanged, omitting it still defaults to raw, and raw still means no adjustments. A typing change, not a price-basis change; the r9 requests send adjustment=raw explicitly.
Feed default rules changed on option market-data endpoints only. Not used by this screen.
The current reference still defines raw as no adjustments and asof=- as skipping symbol mapping. The r9 requests use both explicitly.
Minute bars are still aggregated from SIP trades, truncated to the minute, with the published trade-condition rules; raw still does not imply an immutable vendor archive.

conclusion: No known unresolved raw-SPY adjustment-basis change affecting the registered window was identified in these checked sources since the r8 review of 2026-10-25. A documented applicable change must stop collection or scoring until resolved under the registered rules.
limitations: This records a bounded human documentation review, not proof that no historical vendor change exists.
Undocumented changes, missing corporate actions and later vendor revisions cannot be excluded.
The changelog was read by entry title, opening only market-data entries; it is not an audit of every release.

Before this review, a 2026-11-15 gap count requested SPY minute bars and kept timestamps and counts only (research/intraday/artifacts-2026-11-15-spy-minute-gap-count/). No price or return was stored or read.
